name: Reading Table
text: A long reading table buried in paper.
One yellowed document lies open on top. (Press F to read it.)
inspect: The handwriting is careful and deliberate.
clue: Archive document: 'First comes the light. Then the means of passage. The watcher shall always remain last.'

name: Bookshelf (a binder sticks out)
text: One binder sticks out further than the rest.
You pull it free. A note slips out!
inspect: The note is addressed to whoever wakes up here.
clue: Archivist's note: the cabinet code is hidden in the gallery paintings. Ask your partner.

name: Clerk's Desk
text: A clerk's desk with an open logbook. (Press F to read it.)
inspect: The last page has a short note about the gallery.
clue: Clerk's logbook: the gallery Display Case code is Z first, then X, then Y.

name: Gallery Door
text: A door marked GALLERY. It's locked from the other side.
Your partner is somewhere beyond it.

name: Wiring Panel
title: Fix Wiring
text: The panel cover hangs open. Four wires are loose.

name: Archive Terminal
title: Download Data
text: An old terminal: DOWNLOAD RECORDS FOR EXIT CONTROL.

name: Fuse Box
title: Reset Breakers
text: A fuse box with ten numbered switches, all tripped.

name: Archive Cabinet
title: Open Cabinet
text: A steel cabinet with a 3-digit keypad.
inspect: Three digits. The archivist must have left a note.
hint: The numbers are in the gallery. The order is in the archive.

name: Exit Door
text: The exit door is sealed. A panel says: COMPLETE ALL TASKS.
inspect: The exit unlocks when the team finishes every task in both rooms.
